name: ChatGPT Extension
summary: A simple Manifest V3 Chrome extension that lets you reach OpenAI's ChatGPT from any page on the web. You pin the toolbar icon, click it and ask your question without opening a separate ChatGPT tab.
audience: People who already use ChatGPT and want quick access to it from the browser toolbar.
pros: Opens ChatGPT from any page through the toolbar icon
Built on Manifest V3, Chrome's current extension format
Listed on the Chrome Web Store, with source code on GitHub
cons: Needs a ChatGPT account, so you have to log in or sign up first
Relies on a third-party AI service whose availability and free access the author says are not guaranteed
The source describes it as a really simple extension, so it has few features
